name: RSP Alpha 0.3.1 Framework Mapping Profiler
measurement: exact observed InvokeStatic/InvokeVirtual callsite timing for r6/scripts callers inside explicit F11 capture window
multithread_strategy: thread-owned leaked shards + STOPPING quiescence barrier + post-stop merge
root_barrier: one ACTIVE_ROOTS atomic increment/decrement per observed root chain, not per nested call
frame_strategy: Running-state callback with bool-return compatibility shim on pinned red4ext-rs revision
trust_gates: observed_calls returns to same order as Alpha 0.2 baseline
limitations: not every REDscript intrinsic/VM instruction is observed
exclusive_instrumented_ms is instrumented-edge exclusive time, not guaranteed full VM self time
virtual targets are not guaranteed concrete implementation ownership
target-domain and framework-signal classifications are heuristics
